{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to float, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Calculate mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue_completed = df_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Check the number of completed orders and non-null revenue values
n_completed = len(df_completed)
n_valid_revenue = df_completed['revenue'].count()

mean_revenue_completed, n_completed, n_valid_revenue"}
